summary: A control plane for a company of Claude sessions: seats, gates, and a board.
notes: Three of the estate's six exposed secrets are rookery's, so this file is the first real rotation declaration.

VAULT_APP_KEY.why: The app key rookery reads at boot to fetch its own secrets from vault.

ROOKERY_TOKEN.why: The machine door. The coop bears the same token, so a new value invalidates the coop at the same moment.

DATABASE_URL.why: The owner role's connection string. The password inside it is the role's, so the role is the issuer.
